task: orch-wf1 shell-windows (Windows parity: account report/gate, registry readiness, ssh options, SPW rows)

findings.issue: [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($Path) sits outside the try/catch. The spec asked for a read inside try/catch that counts a failure as empty. With .claude.json, which claude rewrites constantly or which may be foreign-owned under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, an IOException or UnauthorizedAccessException becomes a terminating error. claudeteamup.ps1 and claudeagents.ps1 set EAP=Stop, so the launcher then aborts at step 2, and so does dd.ps1 Step21. A report-only check should never do that.
findings.fix: Move the ReadAllText call inside the existing try, or wrap it in its own try, and return Valid=$false on an I/O error. Test-ClaudeTeamAccount then logs its WARN and sets 'missing'.

findings.issue: ConvertFrom-Json on PS 5.1 and 7 rejects keys that differ only in case. I confirmed this with the snap pwsh: a projects map holding both 'C:/a' and 'c:/a' gives WARN and 'missing'. Windows project keys can plausibly differ only in drive-letter case. On such a host the gate silently fails open for good, while Linux still parses and holds. SPW-046 records the difference, so this is a documented trade-off, not a hidden one. Invalid JSON also re-runs the check in Invoke-ClaudeTeamClaudeProvision, so the OK and WARN lines print twice.
findings.fix: Optional. On PS 7 use ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable, and on 5.1 fall back to System.Web.Script.Serialization.JavaScriptSerializer, so case-duplicate keys still parse. Alternatively, skip the re-run when the config exists but is unreadable.

findings.issue: The live-state list running/running-unverified/stalled/other-lead is written twice: once as a local variable in Start-ClaudeTeamRoles and once as a literal in the hint filter. That is the duplicate-constant pattern AGENTS.md asks to centralize.
findings.fix: Declare $ClaudeTeamLiveStates once in the constants block at the top and use it in both places.
